# LastMinute

LastMinute is a deadline triage web application that helps users decide what work must be completed, reduced, deferred or dropped when remaining workload exceeds available time.

Core features:
- Reality Check
- Minimum Viable Finish
- Must / Reduce / Defer / Kill triage
- Rescue Plan timeline
- Focus Mode
- Live replanning
- Deterministic capacity calculations

Website: https://fawazfff.github.io/Last-minute/
